title: An empty paragraph mark lays out with its inherited ascii face whatever its hint, lang or eastAsia slot say; only an ascii slot changes the line. Missing EA fonts substitute per script
source: probe build.py, Word for Mac direct PDF: empty marks with hint=eastAsia / lang ko-KR / eastAsia=Batang (+hint) all 13.43pt (Calibri 11); mark ascii/hAnsi=Batang 14.3pt; hangul in missing Noto Sans CJK SC -> Batang 1.3029 (advance 1em)

cases.note: hint=eastAsia on the mark: still Calibri
lang eastAsia ko-KR on the mark: still Calibri
eastAsia=Batang on the mark: still Calibri (13.43), not Batang 14.33
ascii/hAnsi=Batang on the mark: Batang line 14.3
missing Noto SC: CJK text in the SimSun/Batang class; SimSun class 1.2970-1.3009, renderer 1.3 (probe 2026-10-22)
